scope: Documentation-review phase: a versioned workspace-provider profile contract with fixtures and an evaluation of Archil's documented behavior against the projected-workspace contract. No Archil account, credential, disk, sandbox, adapter or network call.
immediate_outcome: A declared provider profile that relies on a documented-insufficient mechanism, or claims qualification from a vendor claim or fixture, is refused for its own reason; the evaluation retains Archil as a reference and names branch-per-attempt isolation on a disposable managed flat-block disk as the one mechanism worth qualifying for unrestricted profiles.
durable_capability: config/workspace-provider-profile.ncl (kiln.workspace-provider-profile.v1), its fixtures and tests/workspace-provider-profile.sh in the nickel Nix check.
ordering: The proposal, design and tasks gates were first run after the contract and fixtures were drafted; they passed without changes to the package.

checks.result: pass: three positive profiles export; ten negative profiles are each refused with their own reason
pass (88 positive, 608 negative) after nickel format
pass: Nickel fixture gate (88 positive, 608 negative) and the profile refusal test

baseline.immediate_outcome: The frozen shared corpus (two projects, a shared dependency, an executable file, equal-byte files at two origins and an excluded entry) materializes through the projected materializer for two attempts; all nine local contract checks pass and every Archil outcome stays not_run.
baseline.durable_capability: config/workspace-corpus-contracts.ncl (kiln.workspace-corpus.v1) with its checked export fixtures/workspace-corpus/corpus.json, the harness shared by the off-by-default workspace-baseline example and the workspace_baseline test, and the frozen expectation fixtures/workspace-corpus/expected.json. A later Archil adapter can run the same corpus and checks.

checks.result: pass: reproducible_input, independent_attempts, verified_input_reuse, executable_modes, distinct_origins, excluded_entry_absent, shared_dependency, damaged_input_refused and exact_pin_reopen passed; the receipt is retained as evidence/baseline-receipt.json
pass: 2 passed; the receipt without timings matches fixtures/workspace-corpus/expected.json, and a duplicate path, a single attempt and a wrong schema are each refused with nothing written
pass (94 positive, 619 negative), including the corpus export freshness check and the duplicate-path negative corpus
pass: Nickel fixture gate (94 positive, 619 negative) with the corpus export check, and the profile refusal test

checks.command: cairn gate proposal|design|tasks evaluate-archil-workspace-provider; cairn validate; cairn traceability coverage --profile kiln-active-development
checks.result: gates PASS; validate valid with 0 issues; 1975 of 1975 requirements referenced; the only dangling ID is the pre-existing kiln.dashboard.campaign.projection

evidence_classes.vendor_claim: Every Archil capability in docs/archil-workspace-evaluation.md, from Archil documentation checked 2026-11-17
evidence_classes.deterministic_fixture: The local baseline profile, the contract fixtures and the shared corpus
evidence_classes.local_execution: The local baseline receipt over the frozen corpus; timings describe this host and corpus only

remaining: Operator-run live Archil phase in a disposable environment with named time, resource, cost and retention bounds, running the same corpus and checks.
The two-project build profile of #77; the baseline materializes the corpus but does not build it.
non_claims: The profile contract checks declared capabilities, not provider behavior.
Vendor latency, durability and isolation figures are not Kiln measurements.
No provider is adopted and no default changes.
